exposure: age group (patients 70 years or older vs. patients under 70 years)
cohort: The study included 271 women who underwent uterosacral ligament suspension for treatment of apical prolapse between 2010 and 2020.
finding: Women over the age of 70 undergoing uterosacral ligament suspension for apical prolapse have comparable clinical, anatomical, and composite outcomes to younger patients after multivariate analysis.
